quote.text: Working within our sphere of control, we are naturally free, independent, and strong. Beyond that sphere, we are weak, limited, and dependent.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that as a parent, you wield the power of your own actions and reactions; by working within your sphere of control, you nurture an environment filled with stability and compassion for your children.
    • Accept that you cannot control every aspect of your child's life; instead, focus on guiding them thoughtfully, which fosters independence and resilience in both of you.
  • Leadership
    • A wise leader knows that true strength lies in managing what is within their influence while gracefully letting go of what lies beyond; this clarity inspires respect and trust among followers.
    • Focus on decision-making in areas where you have true agency—by acknowledging limits and empowering your team, you cultivate an environment of accountability and shared growth.
  • Product Management
    • In managing a product, working within your sphere of control means addressing problems you can influence directly, thereby avoiding the pitfalls of frustration over external factors.
    • By directing energy towards internal processes, team collaboration, and iterative improvements, you foster a culture of innovation and sustainable progress despite external market uncertainties.
